title: Excellent picture
content: The picture is sharp, the colors are accurate, and the screen looks excellent in a bright room.

title: Very disappointing
content: The speakers distort at normal volume and the plastic frame feels poorly made.

title: Great image but weak controls
content: The picture quality is excellent, but the remote feels cheap and the menu is slow.

title: Excellent TV despite delivery
content: The TV itself is excellent and easy to set up, but delivery was four days late and the box arrived damaged.

title: Screen keeps flickering
content: Delivery arrived on time and the package was intact, but the screen flickers every few minutes and makes the product hard to use.
The stand is sturdy and installation took less than ten minutes.

title: Good value
content: The price is reasonable for the picture quality and the design looks modern.

title: Feels cheaply made
content: The casing creaks, the buttons feel loose, and the included cable is too short.

title: Average overall
content: The display is fine for casual viewing, the sound is average, and the price feels slightly high.

title: Detailed experience
content: Setup instructions were clear and the slim design fits the room well. Movies look crisp with deep colors, and dialogue is easy to understand at medium volume. The built-in apps cover the major services, although switching between apps sometimes pauses for several seconds and the remote buttons are difficult to identify in the dark.

title: Product issue with normal packaging
content: The package arrived sealed and undamaged, but the device overheats after an hour and restarts without warning.
